caption:
Snow or ice? A pac boot with a felt liner is built for deep snow, not for grip on a frozen sidewalk. Claude and GPT both land on the Sorel Caribou line; GPT adds it is heavy for long hikes. Extreme cold gets Baffin. 1billionmodels.com

Two AI models (Claude Opus 5.5, GPT 6.1 Sol) chose with no web access; nobody tested these products. Synthetic voice. AI-made video.
title: Deep snow or an icy sidewalk? Pick the snow boot for the one you walk on
